name: Service Please
detailed_description:
Service Please is a resource management game where you start as a small business and, over time, transform into a massive restaurant chain.

Customize your business, improve your menu, and continue to grow by increasing customer satisfaction. Make strategic decisions, manage your staff, and serve more customers every day. Success is in your hands!

Design your own business.

  • Create stylish service areas with tables and chairs, and beautify your restaurant with decorative touches.
    The more aesthetic your space, the more customer attention you'll attract!

  • Improve your kitchen equipment to increase efficiency.
    Unlock new recipes, expand your menu, and attract more customers.

  • Shape your beverage menu in your own style!
    Add your unique touch to alcoholic drinks and coffee options to differentiate your restaurant.

Manage your staff and resources.

  • Develop your staff, increase efficiency!
    Enhance the experience levels of your employees to provide faster and more effective service.

  • Use your resources efficiently, stock according to demand!
    Plan material management correctly and keep your stock ready to meet customer demands.

Complete tasks to reach your goals.

  • Successfully complete tasks to progress and earn rewards at every step!

  • Explore the skill tree, unlock desired features, and develop in your chosen areas.

Differentiate the gameplay with events.

  • Organize various events based on customer requests to diversify the gaming experience and attract more attention.
